title: Constant coefficient of the characteristic polynomial
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] of dimension $n=\dim_KV$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], $F:V\to V$ a $K$-linear endomorphism, and $\chi_F(T)=\det(T-F\mid V)$ its characteristic polynomial [def-weil-characteristic-polynomial]. Then

$$
\det(F\mid V)=(-1)^n\,[T^0]\chi_F
$$

[def-weil-endomorphism-determinant], [def-weil-polynomial-coefficient].
